headline: UW-Superior pulls clear of the UMAC
dek: UW-Superior has lost only four times while winning sixteen and drawing three across all matches, scoring 83 goals while conceding 22. That production reaches across the roster, with 21 players on the scoresheet.

pattern.text: Scoring across the UMAC drops off sharply below the top tier: UW-Superior's 83 goals outscore North Central (Minn.), Martin Luther, and Northwestern (Minn.) combined.
